sections.title: Additional Finding: `src/agents/tier1/memory-agent.ts:consolidateMemory` — O(k²) nested search
Additional Finding: `src/agents/base-agent.ts:requestAgent` — Polling loop at 100ms intervals
Corrections to original analysis
sections.content:
Two items from the original analysis need updating based on the full code:

- **`routingHistory` in orchestrator** — already capped at 1000 (same as `alertHistory`). Not a leak.
- **Hashtag DB size** — only ~15 entries. The O(N²) `includes` concern and sort cost are negligible at this scale, though the `Set` fix is still good hygiene if the DB grows.

The polling loop and O(k²) consolidation are now the highest-priority findings.
